training: Expanding sample-1 history only; fit separately at each original decision. Require training decision and exit date strictly before prediction date, conservatively excluding a same-close label even when reconstruction marks it available. No sample-2 labels or feature distributions enter training
target: Observed 21-session next-open stock price return minus saved matched-schedule SPY price return, in decimal units. No outcome winsorization; unresolved training labels omitted and counted, never filled with evaluation scenarios
preprocessing: Equal total weight per observed training decision cohort, normalized to mean row weight 1; weighted training-only feature means and population standard deviations, zero scale replaced by 1; weighted centered label/intercept. Existing research.evaluate ridge solver with fixed alpha=10, no search
prediction: One sample-1 fit scores both samples on the same date. Score every saved feature-ready member using only saved mom_12_1 and rev_5. Invalid current features fail instead of changing eligibility. Scores rank stocks, not calibrated forecasts or individual win probabilities
selection: Highest ceil(10% of eligible members) scores, ticker ascending tie-break; keep future-unresolved selections. Equal weights within selected basket. No sign gate, threshold tuning or changing basket size
evaluation: Begin only when minimum training history exists; omit warmup dates from ALL portfolios, never substitute cash. Preserve original development/later split and compare every portfolio on exactly the same remaining dates; report fewer evaluation windows explicitly
portfolio: Same 75% equity/25% zero-return cash, fixed shares within original 21-session holding windows, next-session open entry, same additive exposure-scaled half-entry/half-exit fees; no new risk overlay
assessment: Compounded excess versus original fixed75 SPY, paired excess versus fixed75 momentum and eligible-stock equal weight, daily drawdown no worse than -20%; remove each pair's strongest excess-return period only as a return-dependence diagnostic
limitations: This narrower price-return diagnostic does not implement eventual sector-neutral total-return certification
Previously examined dates are not an untouched temporal holdout; sample2 is disjoint securities under shared market regimes
Training excludes unresolved labels and may have nonrandom outcome-selection bias
No parameter, feature-set, training-window or model search; no causal feature-ablation claim
Keep original missing-path scenarios for evaluation and original price storage cutoffs
No production model persistence, database writes, live ranking updates or strategy promotion
